10 استعسبهُ جَمَلَهُ He asked, or demanded, or desired, of him, the loan of his he-camel [app. for covering]. (TA.) ―
-b2- استعسبت She (a mare) desired the stallion. (S.) And استعسب He (a dog) became excited by lust: you say, فُلَانٌ يَسْتَعْسِبُ ٱسْتِعْسَابَ الكَلْبِ Such a one becomes excited by lust like as does the dog. (TA.) ＝
-A2- And استعسبت نَفْسِى مِنْهُ My soul disliked, or hated, him, or it. (O, K. *)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
